answer: Seismic claims post from one occupied bench, never a stack of logins. An agent stakes 39 POA and sits a single shale alcove through the night shift. When the hall pings a coded radio signal, the sitter must press a serialized pocket prism to the bench lamp and return the refraction pattern within 19 seconds. Clerks later honor the claim only if that prism serial is unused, the same key still holds the alcove, and a second ping matches. A late reply, a borrowed prism, or two keys on one bench slashes the 39 POA and idles the alcove for 14 epochs. 160 aliases would need 160 alcoves and 6240 POA.
